238:         2.4182711751219577

242:         >>> MLCAnet.plambda = 4
243:         >>> MLCAnet._MLCA__estimate_sigma(x)
244:         >>> MLCAnet.sigma_
245:         2.0493259460083237
246: 
247:         elif (self.num_signal - self.pLambda) > 0:
248:         >>> MLCAnet.num_signal_ = 4
249:         >>> MLCAnet.plambda = 2
250:         >>> MLCAnet._MLCA__estimate_sigma(x)
251:         >>> MLCAnet.sigma_
252:         1.2599210498948732
253:         """
254:         # if self.num_signal == 1:

256:         # elif X.shape[0] < self.pLambda:

261:         elif (self.num_signal_ - self.plambda) > 0:

264:         std_signals = np.std(selected_signals, axis=0, ddof=1)
265:         np.putmask(std_signals, std_signals == 0.0, 1.0e-6)  # If value=0, add a small value for avoiding an error.
266: 
267:         # Silverman's Rule
268:         s = np.power(4 / (2 + self.dim_), 1 / (4 + self.dim_)) * std_signals * np.power(selected_signals.shape[0], -1 / (4 + self.dim_))
269:         self.sigma_ = np.median(s)
